invariants.rationale: Methods typically require a valid (non-null) execution context for processing.
A non-null 'instantTime' string is expected to denote a valid operation time.
An empty string for 'instantTime' would likely be invalid for time-based operations.
'this' must always be non-null in instance method context.
The method is called on an object of HoodieJavaCopyOnWriteTable or its subclass.
